ctx.x: but you can't top your professor. But it's a credit that he has more pupils out here in the world than any drummer including Bishop, including Bertrand... including Cozy which is a wonderful instructor. Oliver Coleman, my very dear friend. I went to see Oliver Coleman when he had cancer and I said, "I'm on my way to California." It was the same year that Nat King Cole died. He would not go to bed. He insisted on getting up out of the bed and driving me to the hotel and getting me some barbecue. I couldn't make…
Bob Rosengarten is one of his students.

Of course. You know, Bob when I was on 44th Street, he'd be down there with Steve Allen, Bob would run up and I'd say, what are you talking about? I'd say, go to Oliver. See, I gave Oliver a key. There's a lot of people wanted a key... this is something I can give to you. You're my friend. Because remember I came through Oliver when his claim to fame when I first met him was 3 or 4 quarts of whiskey a day. He wasn't married. To get him out of that, to get him married, and to take him to Wisdom 102 -
